wintner_wielandt_trace_obstruction.statement: tr([X, P]) = 0 != i*hbar*d for all d < infty
wintner_wielandt_trace_obstruction.conclusion: Continuous canonical commutation relations [X, P] = i*hbar*I have no finite-dimensional representation.

finite_weyl_heisenberg_algebra.generators: Clock X and Shift Z in dimension d
finite_weyl_heisenberg_algebra.commutation_relation: X Z = omega^(-1) Z X, where omega = exp(2*pi*i/d) in Q(zeta_d)
finite_weyl_heisenberg_algebra.unitarity: X^dagger X = I, Z^dagger Z = I
finite_weyl_heisenberg_algebra.conclusion: Finite QM replaces divergent continuous CCR with exact discrete Weyl-Heisenberg unitary operators over Q(zeta_d).

GAP-F001-S000-002.title: Continuum Hilbert lift
GAP-F001-S000-002.rationale: The finite quantum programme operates strictly on finite-dimensional spaces over cyclotomic fields Q(zeta_n) with n | 120. The continuum Hilbert space is an asymptotic completion functor requiring three imported classical hypotheses: (1) Cauchy metric completeness, (2) infinite-dimensional operator domains (to support canonical commutation [X, P] = i*hbar*I), and (3) continuous sphere topology (for Born uniqueness).
